findings.source_quote: “desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby”

findings.translation_quote: “kutamani maziwa ya neno yasiyoghoshiwa, ili kwa hayo mpate kuukulia wokovu: –1 Petro 2:2.”
